thread:
eva: Heads-up: nightly eval on 'long-instruction-set-64k' spiked — ~12% of generations truncated mid-instruction, e.g. last token is '...' instead of full step. Report: https://internal/redwood/evals/64k/17834 :eyes:
noah: Ugh. Is this across models or just the new quantized int8 build?
samira: Looks specific to 64k runs, but I saw some failures on 32k too (much smaller). Could be KV cache offsets getting lost when we stream pods between GPUs.
eva: Eval-bot shows affected model: rwd-3b-qlo-int8@v1.3.3 (nightly). Baseline rwd-3b@v1.3.2 is fine.
kevin: Any logs? can we see `kv_cache_offset` drift? 
eva: here's snippet from runtime logs when failing (trimmed):
```
2026-03-17T23:12:40Z runtime[worker-7]: kv_cache_offset=9830400
2026-03-17T23:12:41Z runtime[worker-7]: apply_kv_patch: offset_delta=4096
2026-03-17T23:12:42Z runtime[worker-7]: kv_cache_offset=9826304
2026-03-17T23:12:42Z runtime[worker-7]: truncated_generation: prompt_end_missing
```
noah: offset went backwards? That's suspicious.
samira: Could be bug in `kv_cache_compact()` after quantized kernel path switch. I remember a fix for overflow handling in v1.3.3 but maybe regressed.
eva: Repro command I used:
```
./eval_harness --model rwd-3b-qlo-int8@v1.3.3 --promptset long-instruction-64k.json --max-tokens 1024 --stream=false --trace-kv
```
kevin: Can someone run `--trace-kv` on a dedicated pod and collect `kv_index_map` dumps? I'll compare with v1.3.2
eval-bot: nightly-eval: long-instruction-64k — failures +12.4% vs baseline, avg latency +18%.
noah: For quick triage: reproduce minimal failing prompt (trim the prompt to last 16k chunk) and see if failure persists. If it disappears, hints at prefix/KV merging.
samira: I'll bisect quantization: int8 vs ql_int8 vs ql_fp16. Also check `kv_cache_shard_size` default (4MB?) — maybe shard boundary alignment causes wrap.
eva: Can someone check if `kv_reset_on_new_request` is toggled for streaming fallback? I saw a change that flips it for streaming in dedicated.
kevin: I'll take ownership. Will run repros and post logs in this thread tonight. Assigning to @kevin :white_check_mark: 
noah: thx. if anyone finds deterministic prompt, ping #eng-oncall to avoid noisy alerts.
samira: Also add a short eval case to nightly harness to assert "instructions preserved" for long contexts.
eva: Good call. added todo in eval board. Thanks all.
